new_findings.title: Two pytest.skip() calls lack GitHub issue links
new_findings.problem: test_empty_history_frame and test_gateway_broker_basic were converted from `pass` placeholders to `pytest.skip()` calls. The skip rationale is well-documented in the docstrings, but neither includes a GitHub issue link as required by test-plan anti-pattern #2. This is a minor formality gap — the skip is legitimate and the rationale is clear.
new_findings.fix: Add a GitHub issue reference to the skip message, e.g., `pytest.skip('GatewayBroker not importable without live app context (see #XXX)')`

M1_weak_assertions.details: ~27 assertions changed from `assert out is not None` to `assert specific_content in to_xml(out)`. Forms error messages, InfoRow labels/values, PositionInfo content, and message alert text all now carry behavioral assertions. Some renderer-only tests still use `assert out is not None` for complex HTML trees, which is acceptable for component renderers.

M4_db_fixture.note: Original finding was LOW severity and non-blocking. Devon did not address this in the fix commits. The db fixture dependency remains implicit.

M5_build_strategy_rows.details: test_build_strategy_rows_with_history now uses a real polars DataFrame with 2 portfolios and asserts specific cell content: strategy name, doc text, portfolio count ('2次'), href target, and date. Exercises the data-rich path (portfolios.is_empty() == False) rather than only the empty DataFrame path.
